verdict.rationale: ClickUp lists a first-party Automations product and says you can trigger workflows from ClickUp events, which covers the event-driven half of the story at a thin level. Nothing in the evidence describes time-based schedules, recurring triggers, or how routine team work would be configured. Missing for 10: documented scheduled/recurring triggers, detail on what Automations can trigger and do, any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create a workflow that runs on a schedule or recurring event to handle routine team work
